comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
That would be this food right here: Mixed Food

If you're ever unsure of an item's translated name, try copying its Japanese name, clicking the Japanese button at the top of the UWO Database, and then pasting the copied item name into the search bar. You can usually find what you're looking for that way. Cheers, and great voyaging to you.
